# pymizu

> Zero-copy shared-memory parallelism across Python and R

## Docs

### API Reference

#### Channels
> A two-way message link between a Python process and a helper process that it spawns.

- [Channel](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/Channel.html): A shared-memory SPSC channel handle (process-private)

#### Channel Methods
> Methods for the Channel class

- [Channel.create](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/Channel.create.html)
- [Channel.attach](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/Channel.attach.html)
- [Channel.token](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/Channel.token.html)
- [Channel.send](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/Channel.send.html)
- [Channel.send_batch](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/Channel.send_batch.html)
- [Channel.recv](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/Channel.recv.html)
- [Channel.recv_batch](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/Channel.recv_batch.html)
- [Channel.close](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/Channel.close.html)
- [Channel.close_signal](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/Channel.close_signal.html)
- [Channel.destroy](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/Channel.destroy.html)

- [Channel.__iter__](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/Channel.__iter__.html)

#### Task pools
> A set of worker processes that divide submitted tasks among themselves.

- [Pool](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/Pool.html): A shared-memory work-stealing task pool handle (process-private)
- [Task](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/Task.html): A task handle from _Pool.submit(). Collected exactly once; an uncollected handle's finalizer releases its slot
- [PreparedMap](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/PreparedMap.html): A map staged once into a persistent region, run many times
- [PoolExecutor](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/PoolExecutor.html): A `concurrent.futures.Executor` over a pymizu pool

#### Cross-language interop
> R peers and workers (the mizu R package), neutral task specifications, and the data.frame's Python home.

- [call](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/call.html): A task specification for a pool of another language's workers
- [r_launcher](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/r_launcher.html): Return a [`Channel.create()`](`pymizu.Channel.create`) launcher
- [r_pool_launcher](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/r_pool_launcher.html): Return a [`Pool.create()`](`pymizu.Pool.create`) launcher
- [Frame](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/Frame.html): A data.frame's Python home: named columns with a row count

#### Frame Methods
> Methods for the Frame class

- [Frame.names](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/Frame.names.html)
- [Frame.row_names](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/Frame.row_names.html)
- [Frame.to_dict](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/Frame.to_dict.html)
- [Frame.__arrow_c_stream__](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/Frame.__arrow_c_stream__.html)
- [Frame.__len__](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/Frame.__len__.html)
- [Frame.__reduce__](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/Frame.__reduce__.html)

#### Outcomes and errors
> Terminal transport states return as the sentinel singletons FULL / TIMEOUT / CLOSED / PEER_GONE (identity-tested, never raised); real failures raise from the exception hierarchy.

- [Sentinel](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/Sentinel.html): Terminal-state sentinel returned by pymizu verbs. Identity-tested against pymizu.FULL / TIMEOUT / CLOSED / PEER_GONE
- [is_sentinel](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/is_sentinel.html): is_sentinel(x) -> bool
- [is_remote_error](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/is_remote_error.html): Test whether a received channel value is a remote error
- [MizuError](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/MizuError.html): Base class for all pymizu errors
- [ShmError](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/ShmError.html): A shared-memory region operation failed. Also an OSError: the failure is at the OS layer
- [StartupError](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/StartupError.html): A channel peer or pool worker failed to attach within the startup timeout
- [SubmitTimeoutError](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/SubmitTimeoutError.html): Pool.submit() timed out waiting for injection-ring space. Also a TimeoutError
- [SlotsExhaustedError](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/SlotsExhaustedError.html): Pool.submit() found no free result slot: too many outstanding (uncollected) tasks
- [StoppedError](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/StoppedError.html): The pool is stopped; no further submission is possible
- [CancelledError](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/CancelledError.html): The task was cancelled before it ran
- [TaskError](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/TaskError.html): The task callable raised. Carries 'remote_type' and 'remote_traceback' attributes describing the worker-side exception
- [WorkerDiedError](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/WorkerDiedError.html): The executing worker died mid-task. Carries 'slot' and 'pid' attributes identifying the worker
- [DeclinedError](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/DeclinedError.html): A send on a foreign-language channel of a value outside the portable interchange subset. Carries 'path' and 'reason' attributes

#### Housekeeping
> The process-wide default pool, the evaluating worker's own pool handle, and orphan reaping.

- [default_pool](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/default_pool.html): The process-wide default pool, or None when none is set
- [set_default_pool](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/set_default_pool.html): Set the process-wide default pool; None clears it
- [using_pool](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/using_pool.html): Use ``pool`` as the default for the with block, then restore
- [current_pool](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/current_pool.html): The evaluating worker's own pool handle, inside a task
- [current_rng](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/current_rng.html): The running element's own numpy Generator, inside a seeded map
- [prune](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/prune.html): Remove orphaned shared memory regions
